title: Persona 5
shortDescription: Atlus's stylish modern JRPG masterpiece following high-school vigilantes 'The Phantom Thieves of Hearts' fighting societal corruption in Tokyo.
historicalSignificance: Revolutionized RPG graphic design with its peerless acid-jazz aesthetic and bold UI typography, achieving universal critical acclaim and catapulting the Shin Megami Tensei spin-off franchise to worldwide mainstream dominance.

editorialContent.overview: Set in modern Tokyo, players inhabit the Joker, a high-school student falsely accused of assault who awakens to the power of his Persona. Together with misfit classmates, he forms the Phantom Thieves, infiltrating the cognitive 'Palaces' of corrupt adults to steal their distorted desires.
editorialContent.gameplay: Meticulously balances turn-based dungeon crawling (elemental weakness targeting, 'One More' turns, and stylish All-Out Attacks) with a strict day-by-day Japanese high school calendar system and social Confidant links.
editorialContent.technicalInnovation: Celebrated worldwide for having the most artistically cohesive and kinetic user interface in gaming history, accompanied by Shoji Meguro's infectious acid-jazz soundtrack with vocals by Lyn Inaizumi.
editorialContent.culturalImpact: Sold over 10 million units across original and Royal editions, cementing the Phantom Thieves mask aesthetic into global pop culture.
editorialContent.preservationNotes: Preserved across PS3 and PS4 discs, and expanded across all modern systems via Persona 5 Royal.

verifiedFactualData.sales: Over 10 million copies sold (including Persona 5 Royal)
awards: The Game Awards Best Role Playing Game 2017
